description: This is an HTML file that implements a web-based database viewer interface, including a sidebar for database selection, dynamic loading of tables and data, and interactive data presentation with expandable cells.
external_files: fetch API calls to endpoints like /api/databases, /api/{db}/tables, /api/{db}/tables/{table}/data

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches and displays list of available databases.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list upon user request.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the table list of a selected database.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Loads the list of tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays data for a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Generates HTML for the data table with expandable cells.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual cell contents based on data type and length.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for detailed view.
